propositions: At search exhaustion with insufficient evidence found, fallback banking incorrectly records met=false (evidence-of-absence) rather than distinguishing exhaustion as a third state (insufficient_evidence).

The tri-state evidence outcome (met, refuted, insufficient) must be persisted as an optional evidence_sufficient:false marker alongside met:false in the bank and schema, following the verdict_obtainable precedent.

The marker must survive the full banking write-path, round-trip harvests, and re-stamp operations without being dropped, while the model-facing record_criterion_verdict tool signature remains bool-only.

Rendering and remediation logic must distinguish insufficient-evidence FAIL verdicts (carry the marker) from genuine refutation FAIL verdicts (bare met=false), emitting different messages and guidance.

Schema, validation (_validate_coverage), finalizer payload (_run_finalizer), and close-gate (close_precheck) must all support and propagate the optional marker while remaining fail-closed on actual failures.
